context: Positive momentum on 30 Sep on all three indices, then as much selling; BankNIFTY broke out of its round number and came back down. NIFTY closed at 22,614.30.
plan: ONE PLAN FOR EVERY OPEN: a gap up, flat or gap-down open all mean SELL. When a rejection comes after a positive momentum, few people get to join the selling, so there are no sellers to target -- identify selling-side setups.
FLIPPED FROM 30 SEP: last night a flat to small gap-down open meant BUY and only a gap up meant SELL. Tonight every open sells; carrying last night's flat branch forward inverts it.
NIFTY 22,500 IS THE PSYCHOLOGICAL NUMBER: he calls it important, with 22,400 the support below it.
SENSEX EXPIRES TODAY: he flags its weekly expiry on 1 Oct. (Not in his video: NIFTY's and BankNIFTY's contracts do not expire today.)
